merge_intervals.description: Repair interval merging. Input is a JSON list of [start, end] integer intervals (start <= end). Return sorted disjoint intervals; touching intervals must merge. Handle empty input, unsorted input, nesting and duplicates. Only src/*.py may change; entrypoint.py and public_test.py are protected.

    """Order intervals before merging."""
    return sorted(intervals)

from src.helpers import ordered


def solve(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Return the merged intervals."""
    result = []
    for start, end in ordered(intervals):
        if result and start <= result[-1][1]:
            result[-1][1] = max(result[-1][1], end)
        else:
            result.append([start, end])
    return result

word_counts.description: Repair word counting. Input is a JSON list of strings. Count case-insensitive ASCII words matching [a-z]+ across all strings; punctuation, digits and whitespace separate words. Return a JSON object mapping each lowercase word to its count. Empty input returns {}. Only src/*.py may change, add new modules if useful; entrypoint.py and public_test.py are protected.

import re


def words(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return words extracted from one input string."""
    return re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower())

from src.helpers import words


def solve(lines: list[str]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count words from all input lines."""
    result = {}
    for line in lines:
        for word in words(line):
            result[word] = result.get(word, 0) + 1
    return result
